state:
**Goal `deprecated-and-todo`, Stage 2: the roster and the template check are on disk. `W1003` is open.** The whole list of goal `php-oracle-retired` is the floor of Stage 1.

ADR 0275 is accepted and its three rules are on disk as `designed`. `Core\Deprecated` is on the roster, its payload is checked against `OPTIONS`, and `check_sites` refuses `construct` off a class (`E0454`) and the attribute on a property hook (`E0844`). The template check is `crates/nvs-types/src/deprecated/template.rs`, and its module doc says how a template is parsed and checked. It parses in `SourceFile::code_at`'s offset-aligned copy, infers in the declaration's scope, and reads what it named from `ExprTypeTable::since(mark)`. The refusals are `E0845` (does not parse), `E0846` (does not compile), `E0847` (does not fit), `E0848` (less visible), `E0849` (names a deprecated declaration) and `E0850` (a class replacement misses a public member). `Env::deprecations` is the program's set of deprecated declarations, `crate::deprecated::Deprecations`, built before any body is checked. All seven tests in `crates/nvs-types/tests/deprecated.rs` pass, and so does `tests/conformance/reject/a-deprecation-template-that-does-not-fit-does-not-compile.nvst`.

**One deviation for the user to confirm:** ADR 0275 § Diagnostics adds no code except the template refusals. The goal also asks that an attach site the attribute does not take be refused, and no existing code says that. `E0844` is that code. If it should go, `E0454` could carry the hook case instead, with a worse message.

Nothing raises `W1003` yet (`crates/nvs-diagnostics/src/lib.rs`, `W_DEPRECATED`).

items.text: **`W1003` at every use** — `rule:attributes/a-deprecation-names-its-replacement-as-code`: every call, `new`, property read or write, class constant, enum case, passed deprecated parameter and type position naming a deprecated class warns, and nothing inside a deprecated declaration or a member of a deprecated class warns. `Deprecations` at `crates/nvs-types/src/deprecated.rs:84` is a set today: widen it to carry `since`, `note` and `replace` for the message. The resolution points are the `ExprInfo::Call` records at `crates/nvs-types/src/expr/calls.rs:212` and `crates/nvs-types/src/expr/calls.rs:586`, `new` at `crates/nvs-types/src/expr/calls.rs:834`, and the property, constant and case records in `crates/nvs-types/src/expr/members.rs`. `crate::deprecated::template::named` already maps each `ExprInfo` to its declaring owner and `Member`, so reuse it rather than writing the mapping a second time. Tests: the names in the goal record's `nvs-types-every-use-of-a-deprecated-member-warns`, beside `crates/nvs-types/tests/deprecated.rs:1`.

**The override warning** — same rule: an override or implementation of a deprecated member warns at the override, with no fix, from the conformance walk `crate::conformance::check_class_conformance` (`crates/nvs-types/src/check.rs:375`).

backlog: A class constant's visibility is not in `ConstSig`, so the less-visible check treats every constant as public (`crates/nvs-types/src/deprecated/template.rs` module doc).
`E0844` versus `E0454` for a deprecation on a property hook: the user's call, see `## State`.
